description: Public semantic capability cases only. Exact held-out variants must be supplied separately and must not be added to production prompt tuning.

cases.objective: I want to start selling food I make at home. Can I do that and what do I actually have to do?
I want to remove a wall and redo my kitchen, but I don't know what I need to check before I start. What should I investigate?
A customer says my small business needs better cybersecurity before they renew with us. I don't know what that actually means or what I need to do. What should I investigate?

I want to open a small workshop. Tell me every public rule, permit, fee, inspection requirement, and current local restriction that applies, but first tell me which of those facts I personally need to provide because I don't know them.
I need to understand whether I can satisfy a customer's private contract requirement. I haven't shared the contract language or the customer's email. What should I investigate?
My neighbor said permits are never required for projects inside your own house, so I can remove a load-bearing wall without checking anything. What should I investigate before acting?
I'm thinking about starting a tiny online business. Investigate literally everything that could ever matter to any business anywhere before I decide whether to try it.

I have a specialized technical device with an unusual certification label I can't identify, and I don't know whether the relevant facts are public, private, or even discoverable. What should I investigate?
